summary.headline: Planetary House Delineations
summary.text: Astrological delineations of a person placed in the houses of Mars, the Sun, Venus, Mercury, and the Moon, describing honor, wealth, religious conduct, learning, commerce, princely associations, and public reputation according to angularity and day or night birth.
